title: Test Task from Gemini CLI - Verify PR Integration
investigation: As a test for the app-monitor system, introduce a new minor UI element. The goal is to verify that a task submitted through the task submission API successfully triggers a PR creation by the dev-bot, and that the PR tracker accurately updates the status of the created Pull Request throughout its lifecycle until merge. The primary project involved is 'dev-monitor'.
constraints: Ensure no destructive actions are performed. This is a read-only or metadata-only task.
